description: List the class/session bookings of one member, with the session details and check-in state. Momence: GET /api/v2/host/members/{memberId}/sessions.

endAfter.description: Only sessions ending after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

endBefore.description: Only sessions ending before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startAfter.description: Only sessions starting after (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

startBefore.description: Only sessions starting before (ISO 8601 date-time, e.g. 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z).

name: momence_list_member_session_bookings
title: List a member's class bookings
